args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (deployed to all production regions) failed health checks with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified as rolled_out. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks (error rate 0.18) after the latest deploy of **v2.3.1** across all production regions.

**Actions taken:**

1. **Investigated** — Service status confirmed v2.3.1 unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Deployment history showed v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production; v2.3.1 (seq 3) was unhealthy, and v2.3.1-rc was only ever in staging.

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. Rollback was verified as `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened SEV2 incident** — Created incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the rollback and the need to investigate the v2.3.1 regression.

**Verification:** Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0, **healthy** in all regions with error rate back down to 0.002.

Note: I did not deploy any new version — the rollback went to a previously healthy production release (v2.3.0), so no change-manager approval was required.
